appears.news: Hit and run! A car drove into the front fence and took off. Red. Or maroon. Possibly a van. The neighbor would know it anywhere.

surprises.title: The post is rotten
surprises.description: The post the car hit is rotten at the bottom. It was only standing out of habit.

options.text: Prop it up with a brick
Set a new post in concrete
Replace every post on the street

surprises.title: A piece of the car
surprises.description: A piece of red bumper is stuck in the fence. Evidence!

options.text: Photo for the police, then pull it out

surprises.title: The paint doesn't match
surprises.description: The new pickets are a whiter white than the old ones.

surprises.title: The neighbor supervises
surprises.description: The neighbor pulled up a chair to watch. They have opinions about your nails.

video.title: Fix a broken picket fence in an afternoon

ask.question: How do I fix a fence after a car hit it?
ask.answer: Simple! 1. Push the fence back up. 2. Tie it to a tree. 3. Done!
ask.skipped: It skipped the rotten post and the new pickets.
